subject: DPA / SCCs: localization obligations and Order Form redlines
messages:
From: Claudia Lopes <claudia.lopes@bluepeak.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: BluePeak Procurement <procurement@bluepeak.com>
Date: 2028-05-09T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Questions on DPA & SCCs scope for EU localisation

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the demo last week — BluePeak legal and procurement asked me to reach back with a couple of items we want clarified before we can approve the Order Form: 

1) Data locality: Order Form section 4 refers to "onshore processing where available" but we need explicit guarantees for EU-resident PII for the pilot (50k requests/month). What options do you have for EU-only processing and can we reflect that in the Order Form / DPA?

2) SCCs: we see your reference to the standard SCCs but need confirmation which SCC module you propose and whether Redwood will sign the updated EU Commission modules (post-2021).

3) Roles: we need a clear controller/processor mapping table and confirmation that any subprocessor list will be provided 30 days prior to onboarding.

I've attached our latest Order Form (v3) and a short spreadsheet of targeted questions. Procurement is on a tight cadence — can we get a proposed redline this week?

Thanks,
Claudia Lopes
Senior Counsel, BluePeak Systems
claudia.lopes@bluepeak.com

Attachments: BluePeak_OrderForm_v3.pdf (application/pdf), BluePeak_DPA_questions.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx)

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Claudia Lopes <claudia.lopes@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-09T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on DPA & SCCs scope for EU localisation

Hi Claudia — thanks for the clear list. Forwarding to our legal and privacy leads and copying Ben on commercial implications. High-level plan below and proposed owners: 

- Quick answers in-line (this note) and a tracked redline to the Order Form + DPA by end of day Friday (Laura / Neha).
- Controller/processor mapping & subprocessor cadence: legal (Laura) to provide explicit table + commitment language (30-day notice).
- SCCs & transfer impact: Neha will recommend module and whether we can adopt the updated modules; if not, we will propose the Transfer Impact Addendum language.
- Localisation: for the pilot we can offer EU-dedicated processing via Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) or Redwood Private (VPC). Laura + Ben to confirm any pricing delta; I will indicate pilot start date flexibility.

Can you confirm the pilot target start date and whether BluePeak requires data residency in a specific country (e.g., DE/NL/IE) or just EU region? That will affect routing and subprocessor selection.

Next steps I propose: 1) Laura/Neha to share a redline and short summary of changes (legal view) by Friday EOD; 2) Ben to send a commercial note on any localization surcharge; 3) schedule a 30-min call early next week to align execs and procurement.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Claudia Lopes <claudia.lopes@bluepeak.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-10T09:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on DPA & SCCs scope for EU localisation

Hi Claudia / team — attaching a tracked redline of the DPA and a short comment memo (DPA_Redline_track.pdf). Key points summarized here: 

1) Data locality: we can commit to EU-region processing for the pilot and will propose an Order Form annex that locks routing to our eu-west-1 region. For country-specific requirements, we are operationally capable but will need the pilot's target country to validate subprocessor availability.

2) SCCs / transfers: Redwood proposes the EU Commission standard contractual clauses for controller-processor transfers (Module: Processor to be attached as appropriate). We are prepared to adopt the updated SCCs; Neha will confirm the exact module language to match BluePeak's controller status. Where SCCs alone are insufficient (e.g., specific government access risks), we propose a short Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) to be appended to the DPA.

3) Roles & subprocessors: attached is a controller/processor mapping table and proposed clause: 

   - Redwood Inference: Processor (processing on behalf of BluePeak)
   - BluePeak Systems: Controller (determines purposes and means)

We will provide a subprocessor list 30 days before onboarding and an operational SLA for data export/return on termination.

Commercial note: locking to EU-dedicated capacity changes the cost profile. Ben — can you confirm whether the pilot falls under standard pricing or requires a localization premium? If there is a surcharge, we will propose either a one-time migration fee or a small recurring uplift for reserved EU capacity.

Proposed next steps: 
- Laura to upload tracked redline (done, attached).
- Neha to follow up with technical transfer-impact language and a short risk mitigation appendix (TIA).
- Ben / Avery to confirm pricing path so we can finalize the order form annex.

Claudia, let me know if you want any of these edits applied directly into your Order Form PDF and returned as a DocuSign packet — happy to do that to keep cycles short.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: DPA_Redline_track.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claudia Lopes <claudia.lopes@bluepeak.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-11T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on DPA & SCCs scope for EU localisation

Claudia — quick commercial note: we can include EU-region processing for the pilot under the following options:

- Option A (recommended for speed): Use Redwood Dedicated EU pool; no change to per-request price but a one-time "reserved capacity setup" fee of $6,000 for the pilot (covers capacity reservation and compliance onboarding).
- Option B (if BluePeak prefers no upfront): Add a 6% monthly uplift to rates while the pilot runs on reserved EU capacity.

If BluePeak is willing to commit to a 12-month reserved capacity term post-pilot, we can waive 50% of the setup fee. I can draft a short commercial appendix for the Order Form that maps these options.

Avery — if procurement confirms which option they prefer, I will prepare a terse amendment and route it via DocuSign. Proposed meeting: Wed 2028-05-16 09:00 PT to finalize legal + commercial.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
